description: The plot illustrates the loss of different models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000 with a tick label interval of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The plot includes six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.3-3.4 at 0 iterations and decreasing to around 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The lines for Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) are closely grouped, with values ranging from approximately 3.32 to 2.5, 3.28 to 2.52, 3.28 to 2.51, and 3.28 to 2.51 respectively. StrmLLM (n=64) starts at around 3.35 and decreases to 2.62, while SepLLM (n=128) starts at around 3.3 and decreases to 2.57. Each line has a shaded region around it, indicating the range of loss values.
